list.emptyBody: Fill-ups recorded in the field app or on this page appear here.

consumption.title: Consumption
consumption.none: Consumption needs two fill-ups with a rising hour meter.
consumption.chooseAsset: Choose a machine to see its consumption in litres per hour.

new.title: Record fill-up
new.litersHint: Use a comma or a dot for decimals.
new.readingsHint: A reading lower than the machine's current one is kept on the fill-up but does not change the machine.
new.filledAtHint: Leave empty to use now. Times use the organisation time zone.
